scope: Whole-assembly, same-input comparison of EDTA 2.3.0, RepeatModeler2 2.0.9 plus RepeatMasker 4.2.4, and the frozen D model on chicken and a second vertebrate assembly

selection_rule.species: Frozen before native execution from existing assembly and label assets; no model score, label density, or interim native output used
selection_rule.input: The complete source FASTA for each assembly, preserving source contig identifiers
selection_rule.labels: Existing same-assembly RepeatMasker/UCSC output is retained as a positive comparator layer; it is not treated as independent exhaustive biological truth
selection_rule.second_genome: Danio rerio danRer11 from the existing same-assembly high-coverage UCSC reference and label assets, fixed before this benchmark; the D. simulans positive-only asset remains outside this primary matrix

chicken.label_scope: UCSC RepeatMasker table on galGal6; used for comparator agreement and label coverage strata
chicken.native_input_contract: complete unmodified galGal6.fa; no train/test selection or contig truncation
chicken.cpu_pilot_record_rule: first source FASTA record with the fixed primary chromosome name chr1; fixed from assembly structure before labels or model output

zebrafish.label_scope: UCSC RepeatMasker table on danRer11; used for comparator agreement and label coverage strata
zebrafish.native_input_contract: complete unmodified danRer11.fa; no train/test selection or contig truncation
zebrafish.cpu_pilot_record_rule: first primary chromosome record with the fixed name chr1; short alternate scaffolds precede it in this FASTA and are not eligible for the 1-Mb pilot

RM2.label: RepeatModeler2 2.0.9 followed by RepeatMasker 4.2.4
RM2.mask_parallelism: RepeatMasker 4.2.4 documents four RMBlast cores per -pa worker; -pa 4 therefore targets 16 search cores under the 16-CPU allocation
RM2.library_policy: Use the one complete native consensi.fa.classified output, including Unknown entries; do not filter by score, class, or downstream label
RM2.classification_policy: Preserve RepeatMasker raw class/family and Unknown rows in native output summaries

EDTA.label: EDTA 2.3.0
EDTA.parameters: --overwrite 1 --sensitive 1 --anno 1 --species others --threads 16; no curated library, CDS, or exclude BED
EDTA.library_policy: Use EDTA's complete native non-redundant TElib output and retain novel/classified/unknown categories separately
EDTA.classification_policy: Preserve native GFF3 attributes; missing or Unknown classification remains Unknown

D.label: Frozen sequence-only D model
D.threshold_policy: existing frozen CAL threshold; no refit on either whole genome
D.output_semantics: binary material runs; no family classification or insertion identity

evaluation.primary: bp-level overlap agreement with the frozen same-assembly positive comparator, reported with label-source scope
evaluation.truth_boundary: No method receives labels. Same-assembly RepeatMasker output is a comparator layer; source-dependent or incomplete labels do not support an exhaustive whole-genome truth claim.
evaluation.class_contract: All native class/family labels remain in the audit. Unknown is never dropped from denominators by post-hoc filtering.

secondary_historical_strata.use: Retrospective reporting strata only. These chromosomes are not asserted to be independent of the D model because the SF5 split is not the D checkpoint exposure manifest.

d_exposure_audit.definition: D-independent chromosomes are fixed before score inspection by excluding every chromosome observed in the D TRAIN, CAL, and model-selection DEV manifests. This is a conservative chromosome-level exposure audit; any unresolved homologous or historical exposure is reported as a retrospective annotation caveat.
d_exposure_audit.independent_test_rule: Only chromosomes explicitly listed under independent_test are used for the D-independent accuracy stratum. Whole-assembly native discovery and timing still use the complete FASTA, and D class is N/A because the frozen D output is binary material inference.
d_exposure_audit.independent_test_selection_rationale: chr10 and chr20 were fixed before reading native outputs or scores because they are present primary assembly chromosomes, absent from every observed D TRAIN/CAL/DEV manifest for the corresponding species, and long enough to provide a non-trivial accuracy stratum. No chromosome was selected by model performance or label density.

native.note: CPU-only requests on the private partition; no GPU is allocated to EDTA/RM2

d_cpu_pilot.input_rule: First complete 1,048,576-bp interval of the first source FASTA contig, fixed before labels and outputs are read
d_cpu_pilot.purpose: Empirical feasibility check for full-genome CPU inference; pilot timing is not whole-genome runtime
d_cpu_pilot.full_run_gate: Submit a full CPU inference only when the pre-specified linear feasibility estimate from the pilot is within the 7-day wall budget; otherwise record a resource-limited CPU result and retain the pilot as the measured CPU deployment datum
